z-m-35-01.title: Xal sheegaya in tirada ardayda midna aan is-diiwaangelin ay tahay 20
z-m-35-01.topic: Dhammaystirka isku-darka iyo isgoyska, iyo tirada curiyayaasha
z-m-35-01.goal: Hal sadar oo xal ah ku hel khaladka ka dhasha turjumidda 'midna ... midna ...' qaabka ururka oo saxo, oo sheeg yaa isla xisaabtu runtii tirinayso.
z-m-35-01.material: Ha ahaato 24-ka arday ee fasalka urur guud U. Is-diiwaangelinta kadib dugsiga, ha ahaato A ururka ardayda is-diiwaangelisay kubadda cagta (13 arday) iyo B ururka ardayda is-diiwaangelisay kubadda koleyga (10 arday), 4 arday-na waxay is-diiwaangeliyeen labadaba. Arday waxay is-diiwaangelin karaan labadaba, ama midna. Jisu wuxuu isku dayay inuu helo 'tirada ardayda midna kubadda cagta midna kubadda koleyga is-diiwaangelin' oo wuxuu u xaliyay sidan. (Sida loo akhriyo astaamaha: Aᶜ waa 'dhammaystirka A', ∪ waa 'isku-darka', ∩ waa 'isgoyska', n(A) waa 'tirada curiyayaasha A'.)

z-m-35-01.s.s1.hint.0: Dooro hal arday. Tusaale ahaan, hubi haddii 'arday is-diiwaangelisay kubadda koleyga oo keliya' uu ku jiro ururka sadarka 1.
z-m-35-01.s.s1.hint.1: Si gooni ah u go'aami haddii ardaygaas uu sidoo kale ka mid yahay 'ardayda midna kubadda cagta midna kubadda koleyga is-diiwaangelin', ee dhibaatadu waydiinayso, oo barbar dhig labada go'aan.
z-m-35-01.s.s1.line.0: 'Ardayda midna kubadda cagta midna kubadda koleyga is-diiwaangelin' waa 'ardayda aan is-diiwaangelin kubadda cagta' ama 'ardayda aan is-diiwaangelin kubadda koleyga', sidaas darteed ururka aan rabno waa Aᶜ∪Bᶜ.
z-m-35-01.s.s1.line.3: Sidaas darteed tirada ardayda midna kubadda cagta midna kubadda koleyga is-diiwaangelin waa 20.
z-m-35-01.s.s1.explain: Ku xidhidda 'is-diiwaangelin kubadda cagta midna kubadda koleyga midna' 'ama' sadarka 1 waa halka ugu horreysa ee ay ka khaldanto. Si aan midna is-diiwaangelin, waa inay noqotaa 'ma is-diiwaangelin kubadda cagta oo sidoo kale ma is-diiwaangelin kubadda koleyga', sidaas darteed waa Aᶜ∩Bᶜ, taasoo ah, (A∪B)ᶜ. Aᶜ∪Bᶜ=(A∩B)ᶜ ee sadarka 2 keligeed way sax tahay xisaabta sadarka 3 (24−4=20) sidoo kale waa sax, laakiin ururka sadarka 1 la doortay waa kala duwan yahay, sidaas darteed gabagabada sadarka 4 waa khalad.

z-m-35-01.s.s2.hint.0: Samee jadwal imisa arday ayaa is-diiwaangeliyay kubadda cagta oo keliya, kubadda koleyga oo keliya, iyo labadaba.
z-m-35-01.s.s2.hint.1: 24-ka oo dhan dhexdooda, qor koox ahaan noocyada ardayda ee ku jira 20-ka hadhay kadib ka jarista 4.

z-m-35-01.s.s2.r.c: 'Hal oo keliya' waa inay ka reebtaa ardayda is-diiwaangelisay labadaba iyo ardayda midna is-diiwaangelin. Hubi haddii ay la mid tahay xisaabta ka jarta 4 oo keliya 24.
z-m-35-01.s.s2.o.d: Ardayda is-diiwaangelisay kubadda cagta oo aan is-diiwaangelin kubadda koleyga
z-m-35-01.s.s2.r.d: Ardaydaasi waa qaybta A ee laga saaray A∩B. Hubi haddii taasi ku habboon tahay xisaabta isticmaalaysa 24 oo laga bilaabo qof walba.
z-m-35-01.s.s2.explain: 24−4 wuxuu ka jaraa 4-ta arday ee is-diiwaangeliyay labadaba oo keliya qof walba, sidaas darteed waa wadarta kubadda cagta oo keliya (13−4=9 arday) + kubadda koleyga oo keliya (10−4=6 arday) + ardayda midna is-diiwaangelin. 9+6+(5 arday oo midna is-diiwaangelin)=20, taasoo la mid ah tirada curiyayaasha (A∩B)ᶜ.

z-m-35-01.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore, 'ama' ee sadarka 1 ku dabaq sida weedh hal arday, oo go'aami waxa loo beddelayo.
z-m-35-01.s.s3.hint.1: Kadib helidda tirada curiyayaasha ururka la saxay, ku dar tirada ardayda is-diiwaangelisay kubadda cagta oo keliya, kubadda koleyga oo keliya, iyo labadaba, oo hubi inay waafaqayso 24.

z-m-35-01.s.s3.model.0: Sadarka 1 waa in la saxaa. Si aan midna is-diiwaangelin, waa 'ma aha kubadda cagta oo ma aha kubadda koleyga', sidaas darteed waa Aᶜ∩Bᶜ, taasoo ah, (A∪B)ᶜ. n(A∪B)=13+10−4=19, sidaas darteed 24−19=5 arday. Isku darka kubadda cagta oo keliya 9, kubadda koleyga oo keliya 6, iyo labadaba 4 sidoo kale wuxuu siinayaa 19, sidaas darteed way ku habboonaatay.

z-m-35-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Jawaab lagu hubiyay isku darka koox ahaan halkii laga isticmaali lahaa qaacidada isku-darka.

z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kadib imaanshaha ardayga wareegga ah, iyadoo 25 arday ay yihiin ururka guud, maxaa dhici lahaa haddii hadda isla odhaahda laga xukumo?

z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Horay ayaa loo go'aamiyay inay run tahay fasalkan, sidaas darteed ma beddelmi doonto xitaa marka ardayga wareegga ah uu yimaado

z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Haddii arday uu isticmaalo waa xaqiiqo lagu xaqiijiyay diiwaanno, ma aha qiyaas. Kala sooc macluumaadka la xaqiijiyay iyo filashada.

z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Waxaad tilmaantay in maadaama ay jirto arday marka ugu horreysa buuxiya p, haddii q ee ardaygaas uu run yahay ama been yahay uu go'aamin doono runta odhaahda.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Ardayga wareegga ah ayaa yimid, hubintana waxay yidhaahdeen ardayga ma isticmaalo qolka akhriska B. Macluumaadka ku saabsan 24-kii arday ee asalka ahaa ma isbeddelin.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Sidee ayaad u soo koobi lahayd odhaahda 25-ka arday iyo xukunka loo sameeyay 24-kii arday ee asalka ahaa?
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.after: 25-ka arday, ardayga wareegga ah, oo 192 cm ah oo aan isticmaalin qolka akhriska B, waa tusaale ka soo horjeedda, sidaas darteed odhaahdu waa been. z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: 25-ka arday waa been, 'run' ee 24-ka arday-na weli waa sax ururkaas
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Waxaad kala saartay ururka guud oo beddelmay iyo xukunkii ugu horreeyay oo khaldan.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Xukunkii ugu horreeyay wuu khaldanaa, sidaas darteed kan 24-ka arday waa in loo saxaa been sidoo kale
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: 24-ka dhexdooda arday 190 cm ah ama ka dheer ma jirin, sidaas darteed tusaale ka soo horjeedda ma jirin. Waxa beddelmay waa ururka guud.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Waxaa jira hal arday wareeg ah oo keliya, sidaas darteed inta badan waa la raacaa, sidaas darteed weli waxaan u tixgelinayaa run
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: 'Haddii p markaas q' waa run ma aha marka inta badan ay sii jirto laakiin marka aan jirin hal tusaale ka soo horjeedda. 'Inta badan way sii jirtaa' waa sheegasho kale.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Dib u dhig xukunka ilaa diiwaannada isticmaalka ardayda kale oo dhan la xaqiijiyo
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: 24-ka kale p ma buuxiyaan. Ka fikir haddii diiwaannadoodu beddeli karaan haddii ay jirto tusaale ka soo horjeedda.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.reflect: Saddexda tallaabo dhexdooda, maxaa beddelmay maxaana sidiisii ahaa xukunkayga? Haddii aad kala saarto 'kiis la hubiyo ma jiro' iyo 'kiis ka hor imanaya ma jiro', sidee xukunka tallaabada koowaad u beddelmaa?
z-m-35-02.s.s2.prompt: Adigoo isticmaalaya ereyga 'tusaale ka soo horjeedda', saaxiib u sharax sababta 'haddii p markaas q' loo tixgeliyo run marka curiye midna uusan buuxin p. Sidoo kale ku dar hal tusaale kale oo isla qaab ah (shuruud ku saabsan tirooyin).
z-m-35-02.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore hal weedh ku qor nooca curiye ee ay tahay inuu jiro si 'haddii p markaas q' ay been u noqoto.
z-m-35-02.s.s2.hint.1: Samee hal shuruud (ku saabsan tirooyin) oo curiye midna uusan buuxin p, oo tijaabi haddii weedha sheegaysa curiyahaas inuu jiro uu sii jiro.
z-m-35-02.s.s2.placeholder: Tusaale: Si ay been u noqoto waa inay jirtaa ..., laakiin ...

z-m-35-02.s.s2.model.0: Haddii ay run tahay ama been tahay waxaa go'aamiya haddii ay jirto tusaale ka soo horjeedda. Haddii arday 190 cm ah ama ka dheer midna uusan jirin, arday sidaas oo kale ah oo aan isticmaalin qolka akhriska B ma jiri karo, taasoo ah, tusaale ka soo horjeedda ma jiro, sidaas darteed been looma yeedhi karo, sidaas darteed waxaan u tixgelinayaa run. Tusaale isla qaab ah, 'haddii x uu yahay dhab ah iyo x²<0, markaas x>5' sidoo kale tiro dhab ah oo leh x²<0 ma jirto, sidaas darteed tusaale ka soo horjeedda ma jiro, sidaas darteed waa run.
z-m-35-02.s.s2.model.1: Si "haddii p markaas q" ay been u noqoto, waa inay jirtaa ugu yaraan hal kiis p uu run yahay q-na khaldan yahay. Laakiin haddii aan jirin kiis midna buuxinaya p, tusaale ka soo horjeedda caynkaas ah ma jiri karo, sidaas darteed waa run. Tusaale ahaan, "haddii x² < 0 tiro dhab ah x, markaas x > 5" sidoo kale waa run sababtoo ah x dhab ah oo leh x² < 0 ma jirto. Marka la eego ururada, waa isla sheeko sida ururka madhan uu u yahay urur-hoose ururka kasta.
z-m-35-02.s.s2.modelNote.1: Waxaa lagu sharaxay adigoo ku xidhaya ururada.

z-m-35-04.prereq.0: H1 ee hawshan waa calaamad adkaan oo kooxda soo saarka ah oo keliya, ma aha qoondayn fasal ee manhajka. Waxay u qaadanaysaa in bartaha uu horay u bartay unugga 'ururada iyo odhaahyada' ee Xisaabta Guud ee dugsiga sare hal mar (hawlaha ururada, odhaahda 'haddii p markaas q', iyo tusaalayaasha ka soo horjeedda).
z-m-35-04.title: Marka hal qiime uusan ka tirsanayn mid ka mid ah labada urur
z-m-35-04.topic: Ururka runta shuruud iyo qiimaha xadka (haddii ay jirto calaamad simanaan)
z-m-35-04.goal: Hubi halka qiimaha xadku ka tirsan yahay ururka runta dheeloob shuruud si aad u xukunto haddii 'ama' had iyo jeer run yahay, oo naftaada samee dhowr xaaladood oo buuxiya xaddidaadyada la bixiyey shuruud halka booska calaamadda simanaanta is beddelay.
z-m-35-04.material: Tiro dhab ah x, deji shuruudaha iyo ururadooda runta sida soo socota. [가] p: x<a, q: x>b. [나] p: x<a, q: x≥b. Halkan a iyo b waa joogtooyin, P iyo Q na waa ururka runta p iyo q siday u kala horreeyaan. Minjae wuxuu xaaladda a=b=3 ee [가] u xalliyey sidan. (Sida loo akhriyo: ≥ macnaheedu waa 'ka weyn ama la simanyahay', x<a na macnaheedu waa 'x wuu ka yar yahay a'.)
z-m-35-04.prereq.1: Muujinta ururada runta ee dheeloobyada x<a iyo x≥b xariijinta tirooyinka
z-m-35-04.prereq.2: In ururka runta shuruudda 'p ama q' uu yahay P∪Q
z-m-35-04.s.s1.prompt: Xaggee ayay sadarka ugu horreeya ee xalka Minjae mantiqu ka khaldantay? Sadarrada laga tiri 1.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.hint.0: P iyo q ee sadarka 1 lagu dejiyey, tiro dhab ah kasta u kala saar inay ka tirsan tahay p ama q.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ka fikir x kee ayaa ku jira "tiro dhab ah x kasta," oo sadar sadar hubi haddii sadar kasta wax ka qabtay dhammaan x-kaas.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.line.0: Ha noqdo a=b=3. Markaas p waa x<3 q na waa x>3.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.line.1: Haddii x ka yar yahay 3, p waa run, haddii x ka weyn yahay 3 na, q waa run.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.line.2: Xaaladda x=3 maaha ka yar iyo ka weyn 3, sidaa darteed ma ka tirsana dhinac, sidaa darteed looma baahna in si gooni ah loo tixgeliyo.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.line.3: Sidaa darteed, tiro dhab ah x kasta, 'p ama q' waa run.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.explain: Dhibaatadu waxay tahay in sadarka 3 uu laftiisa sheegay x=3 inaanu ka tirsanayn midna shuruud oo ka dib yiri 'looma baahna in si gooni ah loo tixgeliyo'. 'Tiro dhab ah x kasta' waxay ka kooban tahay x=3 sidoo kale, haddii p iyo q labaduba been yihiin x=3, markaas 'p ama q' waa been, sidaa darteed [가] ma odhan kartid haddii a=b waa run tiro dhab ah kasta. Gunaanadka sadarka 4 waa khalad sadarka 3 awgeed.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.prompt: Hadda, [나] (p: x<a, q: x≥b), samee 3 lammaane oo kala duwan (a, b) oo buuxiya dhammaan kuwa soo socda. (i) 'p ama q' waa run tiro dhab ah x kasta. (ii) Waxaa jira saxda 2 tiro dhan x oo isla mar buuxiya p iyo q. a iyo b waxay noqon karaan tobanaadyo.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.hint.0: Sawir P iyo Q xariijinta tirooyinka oo go'aami halka b iyo a ay tahay inay ku jiraan si ay u isku xidhmaan kala fogaansho la'aan.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.hint.1: Liis ka dhig tirooyinka dhan ee kala duwanaanshaha laga bilaabo b ilaa laakiin aan ku jirin a, oo hagaaji a iyo b si ay saxda 2 u noqdaan.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Tiro dhab ah midna lama ka tagin (shuruudda (i)).
z-m-35-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Haddii b ka weyn yahay a, tirooyinka laga bilaabo a ilaa laakiin aan ku jirin b ma buuxiyaan p ama q.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Waxaa jira saxda 2 tiro dhan laga bilaabo b ilaa laakiin aan ku jirin a (shuruudda (ii)).
z-m-35-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Tirada tirooyinka dhan laga bilaabo b ilaa laakiin aan ku jirin a maaha 2.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.explain: [나], P waa a ka hooseeya Q na waa b ama ka sarreeya. Si isu-keenidda ay u noqoto dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah, b≤a ayaa loo baahan yahay, tirooyinka isla mar buuxiya labadaana waa laga bilaabo b ilaa laakiin aan ku jirin a. Way ku filan tahay in saxda 2 tiro dhan halkaas ku jiraan, sidaa darteed tusaale ahaan (3,1) wuxuu ka kooban yahay 1, 2, (2.5,0.5) wuxuu ka kooban yahay 1, 2, (4.2,2.3) na wuxuu ka kooban yahay 3, 4. Haddii b=a, tiro is-dulsaaran ma jirto gabi ahaanba, sidaa darteed (ii) lama buuxiyo.

z-m-35-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Dej a=b=3 oo geli x=3 p iyo q ee [나], oo qor mid walba run mise been.

z-m-35-04.s.s2.because.model.0: [나], haddii a=b, P waa a ka hooseeya Q na waa a ama ka sarreeya, sidaa darteed x=a wuxuu galaa Q. z-m-35-04.s.s2.because.model.2: [나], marka b=a, P waa x<a Q na waa x≥a, sidaa darteed waxay u kala qaybiyaan dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah iyagoo is-dulsaarin la'aan, laakiin [가], x=3 ma ka tirsana P ama Q, sidaa darteed isu-keenidda maaha dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah.

z-m-35-05.title: Laba weedh oo leh isla erayo laakiin kala horreyn kale: ma isku macno ayay yihiin?
z-m-35-05.topic: Kala horreynta weedhaha leh labadaba 'dhammaan' iyo 'qaar'

z-m-35-05.material: Afar arday 가, 나, 다, 라 waxay midba midka kale u direen qoraallo gargaar. Qofna naftiisa ma direyn. Sadar kasta oo shaxda ah waa 'direyaha → qaataha'. z-m-35-05.s.s2.line.1: Dhinaca qaataha eegista, 가, 나, 다, 라 mid walba wuxuu helay hal qoraal, sidaa darteed ㄱ waa run.
z-m-35-05.s.s2.line.2: Arday kasta oo helay qoraal macnaheedu waa arday kasta wuxuu leeyahay direye, sidaa darteed waxaa raacaya in hal arday u diray dhammaan ardayda kale.
z-m-35-05.s.s2.line.3: Sidaa darteed ㄴ sidoo kale waa run [Shaxda 2].
z-m-35-05.s.s2.explain: Ilaa sadarka 2 waa sax (ㄱ waa run [Shaxda 2]). Sadarka 3 wuu khaldamay isagoo leh 'arday kasta wuxuu leeyahay direye' (direyuhu wuu kala duwanaan karaa qaate kasta), 'hal arday u diray qof walba' (isla direye qof walba) ayaa raacaya. [Shaxda 2], arday kasta wuxuu u diray hal qof oo keliya, sidaa darteed ㄴ waa been. Gunaanadka sadarka 4 waa khalad sadarka 3 awgeed.
z-m-35-05.s.s3.prompt: Iyadoo lagu salaynayo labada shax, xukun haddii 'haddii ㄴ run yahay ㄱ waa lagama maarmaan run' iyo 'haddii ㄱ run yahay ㄴ waa lagama maarmaan run' mid walba had iyo jeer run yahay, oo qor shaxda kee ayaa caddayn u ah xukun kasta.
z-m-35-05.s.s3.hint.0: Qor haddii ㄱ iyo ㄴ ay run yihiin mise been [Shaxda 1], oo isla wax sameey [Shaxda 2].
z-m-35-05.s.s3.hint.1: Isticmaal xaqiiqada ah haddii ay jirto shax halka mid run yahay mid kalena been yahay, 'lagama maarmaan' jihada taas waa jabtay.
z-m-35-05.s.s3.placeholder: Tusaale: Xataa haddii ㄴ run yahay, ㄱ ... Shaxda 1 ...
z-m-35-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma si gooni ah u xukumay labada jiho (ㄴ→ㄱ, ㄱ→ㄴ)?
z-m-35-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shaxaha aan bixiyey, ma si gaar ah u tilmaantay in hal hadal run yahay kan kalena been yahay?
z-m-35-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma ereyadaada ku sheegtay in macnaha is beddelo haddii kala horreynta 'dhammaan' iyo 'qaar' kala duwan tahay?
z-m-35-05.s.s3.model.0: Midna had iyo jeer ma run yahay. Shaxda 1, ㄴ waa run laakiin ㄱ waa been sababtoo ah cidna 가 uma direyn. Shaxda 2, ㄱ waa run laakiin ㄴ waa been (direye kasta wuxuu u diray hal qof oo keliya). Sidaa darteed waxaa jira hal tusaale oo lid ku ah mid walba.
z-m-35-05.s.s3.model.1: Xataa haddii ㄴ run yahay, dammaanad ma jirto in ㄱ run yahay (Shaxda 1 waa tusaale lid ku ah), xataa haddii ㄱ run yahay, dammaanad ma jirto in ㄴ run yahay (Shaxda 2 waa tusaale lid ku ah). In arday kasta leeyahay direye iyo in hal arday u diray qof walba macnaha way kala duwan yihiin sababtoo ah kala horreynta 'dhammaan' iyo 'qaar' way kala duwan tahay.
z-m-35-05.s.s3.model.2: Shaxda 1, ㄴ waa run ㄱ na waa been, shaxda 2 na, ㄱ waa run ㄴ na waa been, sidaa darteed midna lama dammaanad qaado.

z-m-35-06.prereq.0: H1 ee hawshan waa calaamad adkaan oo kooxda soo saarka ah oo keliya, ma aha qoondayn fasal ee manhajka. Waxay u qaadanaysaa in bartaha uu horay u bartay unugga 'ururada iyo odhaahyada' ee Xisaabta Guud ee dugsiga sare hal mar (hawlaha ururada, odhaahda 'haddii p markaas q', iyo tusaalayaasha ka soo horjeedda).
z-m-35-06.title: Naftaada dhisidda laba shuruudood oo leh tirada tusaalayaal lid ku ah oo go'an
z-m-35-06.topic: Tirinta tusaalayaasha lid ku ah hindisaha 'haddii p markaas q' iyo ka soo horjeedkiisa (ku jirista ururada runta)
z-m-35-06.goal: Isticmaal xaqiiqada ah farqiga ururada runta waa ururka tusaalayaasha lid ku ah si aad naftaada u naqshadayso laba shuruudood oo buuxiya xaddidaadyada tirada tusaalayaasha lid ku ah, oo isbarbar dhig dhowrka xal.
z-m-35-06.material: Ururka guud U={1, 2, 3, …, 12}, tixgeli laba shuruudood p: x≥a, q: x≤b. a iyo b waa tirooyin dhan laga bilaabo 1 ilaa 12, P iyo Q na waa ururada runta p iyo q siday u kala horreeyaan. Tusaale lid ku ah hindisaha 'haddii p markaas q' waa xubin U ah oo p run yahay q na been yahay, tusaale lid ku ah ka soo horjeedkiisa 'haddii q markaas p' na waa xubin q run yahay p na been yahay. (Sida loo akhriyo: x≥a waa 'x waa ugu yaraan a', x≤b na waa 'x waa ugu badnaan b'.)
z-m-35-06.thinking.0: Muujinta tusaalayaasha lid ku ah sida ururro
z-m-35-06.thinking.2: Isbarbar dhigga qaab-dhismeedka xalalka kala duwan
z-m-35-06.prereq.2: Ka soo horjeedka hindise, 'haddii q markaas p'
z-m-35-06.s.s1.prompt: Kee ayaa ugu fiican oo muujiya tusaalayaasha lid ku ah hindisaha 'haddii p markaas q' adigoo isticmaalaya ururada runta P iyo Q?
z-m-35-06.s.s1.hint.0: Naftaada dooro hal ama laba xubnood oo U ah oo waafaqsan macnaha tusaale lid ku ah ('shuruudda p waa run laakiin gunaanadka q waa been').
z-m-35-06.s.s1.hint.1: Qor kee ka mid ah P iyo Q ayuu xubintaasi ka tirsan yahay iyo kee ma ka tirsana.
z-m-35-06.s.s1.o.a: Xubin ka tirsan P oo aan ka tirsanayn Q (P−Q)
z-m-35-06.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad macnaha tusaale lid ku ah, 'p waa run laakiin q waa been', u tarjuntay luqadda ururada.
z-m-35-06.s.s1.o.b: Xubin ka tirsan Q oo aan ka tirsanayn P (Q−P)
z-m-35-06.s.s1.r.b: Xubnahani waa kuwa jebiya 'haddii q markaas p'. Mar kale eeg xaqiiqada ah in tusaale lid ku ahi uu yahay xubin halka 'dhinaca shuruudda uu run yahay dhinaca gunaanadkuna uu been yahay'.
z-m-35-06.s.s1.o.c: Xubin ka tirsan P iyo Q labadaba (P∩Q)
z-m-35-06.s.s1.r.c: Xubin p iyo q labaduba run yihiin ma jebiso 'haddii p markaas q' dhab ahaan wuu taageeraa. La barbar dhig macnaha tusaale lid ku ah.
z-m-35-06.s.s1.o.d: Xubin aan ka tirsanayn P ama Q
z-m-35-06.s.s1.r.d: La barbar dhig macnaha tusaale lid ku ah doorka xubin p iyo q labaduba been yihiin ku leeyihiin 'haddii p markaas q'.
z-m-35-06.s.s1.explain: Tusaale lid ku ah 'haddii p markaas q' waa xubin p run yahay q na been yahay, taasi waa, xubin ka tirsan P oo aan ka tirsanayn Q, sidaa darteed waa P−Q (=P∩Qᶜ). Tusaale lid ku ah ka soo horjeedka 'haddii q markaas p' waa Q−P.
z-m-35-06.s.s2.prompt: Samee 3 (a, b) oo kala duwan oo buuxiya dhammaan shuruudaha soo socda. (i) Waxaa jira saxda 3 tusaale lid ku ah 'haddii p markaas q' U. (ii) Ka soo horjeedka 'haddii q markaas p' wuxuu leeyahay ugu yaraan 1 tusaale lid ku ah iyo wax ka yar 3.
z-m-35-06.s.s2.hint.0: Hal a iyo b go'aami, qor P iyo Q tirooyinka 1 ilaa 12, oo tiri tirooyinka ka tirsan P oo keliya.
z-m-35-06.s.s2.hint.1: Si ay 3 tiro uga tirsan yihiin P oo keliya, go'aami halka P ay tahay inay ka bilaabanto iyo halka Q ay tahay inay ku dhammaato, kadibna hubi imisa tiro ayaa ka tirsan Q oo keliya.

z-m-35-06.s.s2.explain: P={a, …, 12}, Q={1, …, b}. P−Q waa tirooyinka laga bilaabo max(a, b+1) ilaa 12, sidaas darteed si tirada ay u noqoto 3, max(a, b+1)=10. Sidoo kale Q−P waa tirooyinka laga bilaabo 1 ilaa min(b, a−1), sidaas darteed tirada tusaalooyinka diidmada ee rogaalka waa min(b, a−1), waana inay noqotaa 1 ama 2. Lammaanayaasha suurtagalka ah waa afartan oo keliya (2,9), (3,9), (10,1), (10,2).
z-m-35-06.s.s3.prompt: Dooro laba ka mid ah lammaanayaasha (a, b) ee aad heshay oo qaabab kala duwan leh, isbarbar dhig sida P iyo Q ugu yaalaan liiska tirooyinka (haddii ay is dul dhacaan mise kala goosan yihiin), oo qor sababta labada lammaane u buuxiyaan shuruudaha.
z-m-35-06.s.s3.hint.0: Lammaane kasta oo aad heshay, ku qor P iyo Q adigoo isticmaalaya tirooyinka 1 ilaa 12 oo hubi haddii tiro ay labada urur ku jirto.
z-m-35-06.s.s3.hint.1: Haddii ay qaabab kala duwan leeyihiin, isbarbar dhig urur kee ayaa dhinac ku yaal.
z-m-35-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Labada lammaane, ma qoray si gaar ah tirooyinka P oo keliya ka tirsan iyo Q oo keliya ka tirsan?
z-m-35-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma sheegay si cad sida qaabka labada lammaane u kala duwan yahay (haddii ay is dul dhacaan)?
z-m-35-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma hubiyey haddii ay jiraan lammaane kale oo aan seegay?
z-m-35-06.s.s3.model.0: Haddii (a, b)=(2, 9), P waa 2 ilaa 12 Q-na waa 1 ilaa 9, sidaas darteed way is dul dhacaan. 10, 11, 12 oo P oo keliya ku jira waa 3 tusaale diidmo, 1 oo Q oo keliya ku jirta-na waa 1 tusaale diidmo ee rogaalka. Haddii (10, 1), P waa 10 ilaa 12 Q-na waa 1 oo keliya, sidaas darteed way kala goosan yihiin, 10, 11, 12 oo P oo keliya ku jira waa 3 tusaale diidmo, 1 oo Q oo keliya ku jirta-na waa 1 tusaale diidmo ee rogaalka.
z-m-35-06.s.s3.model.1: Haddii a=3, b=9, P waa 3 ama ka badan Q-na waa 9 ama ka yar, sidaas darteed qaybta is dul dhacaysa waa 3 ilaa 9, qaybta P oo keliya waa 10, 11, 12 (3 tiro), qaybta Q oo keliya-na waa 1, 2 (2 tiro). 2 tusaale diidmo ee rogaalka waa ka yar yihiin 3. Haddii a=10, b=2, markaas P (10 ilaa 12) iyo Q (1 ilaa 2) ma is dul dhacaan, iyadoo 3 tiro P oo keliya ay ku jiraan iyo 2 tiro Q oo keliya.
